prompts.task: Implement cache interceptor with TTL by route
prompts.template:
Implement a custom cache interceptor for NestJS that:
- Caches GET responses with configurable TTL per route
- Uses @CacheTTL(seconds) decorator for per-route TTL
- Invalidates cache on POST/PUT/DELETE to same route
- Uses Redis or in-memory store

Available skills: {skills}
constraints: Cache key = method + URL + user ID (if authenticated)
Skip cache when ?nocache=1 query param present
